lessons: The ticket requires phase3-continue to embed tests/test_seeded_phase3_core.py as its idiom. 19.L forbids this: a continuation embeds one merged earlier seeding test, never the test created in its own admission. That file is created on this branch and is absent at Check.

The requisition_review paved road agrees with 19.L: `## Context` lists only existing files. A file the ticket creates goes in `## Scope fence` or `## Verification`. No ticket edit can satisfy both this ticket's scope line and the gate.

Fix the ticket so phase3-continue embeds a merged earlier seeding test that exists on main, such as tests/test_seeded_phase2.py (this ticket's own Context). Then regenerate phase3-continue. Leave the approved daemon-scheduler and merge-queue seeds unchanged.
Keep tests/test_seeded_phase3_core.py inside the fence as this branch's committed test. The suite passed (19 core tests, 729 in all) and was approved. Only the Context line in phase3-continue failed.
